stem.text: Radio waves can be polarised, but sound waves **cannot** be polarised.
Which statement gives the reason for this?

A.text: Radio waves are generally of a higher frequency than sound waves.

B.text: Radio waves are transverse waves, but sound waves are longitudinal waves.

C.text: Radio waves can travel through a vacuum, but sound waves **cannot** travel through a vacuum.

D.text: Radio waves travel at a much higher speed than sound waves.
